description: A bearded man in gold-trimmed scale armour and a dark red cloak stands at the carved prow of a wooden galley, hand on a sword. At upper left is a gold-framed Madonna and child icon with Greek-style letters painted at its top corners. Behind him are helmeted men; on the right, sailing galleys cross dark water toward a walled domed city under a stormy sky. Oil painting, filling the image edge to edge.
reason: Letters (MP and ΘΥ style Greek abbreviations) are painted at the top of the icon at upper left. Repaint the icon without lettering or crop it out.
